evidence_quotes.O: I am not an audiophile and when talk turns to impedances and ohms my eyes glaze over. I want a solid system that sounds great.
evidence_quotes.C: For months I studied reviews of different models on the internet hoping to at least discover which manufacturers had the most service problems to avoid that aggravation
evidence_quotes.E: so I can take great shots while at a ball game all in a compact body.
evidence_quotes.A: I readily admit that $50,000 worth of speakers would undoubtedly be wasted on me.
evidence_quotes.N: Speakers that are not subwoofers, yet muddy everything with heavy bass response, or those that have tinny upper ranges because of subpar tweeters are intolerable.
